resources.name: Periodic DFT code (e.g., NWChem, PySCF) supporting B3PW hybrid functional, Gaussian basis sets, and effective core potentials

access.notes: Open-source implementations of hybrid DFT with Gaussian basis sets and ECPs are available in NWChem, PySCF, and others. The paper used CRYSTAL'98, but any code with the required features reproduces the results.

resources.name: Gaussian basis set contractions for O, Ti, Sr, Ba (Piskunov et al. 2004)

access.notes: Basis sets: O 8-411(1d)G, Ti 411(311d)G, Sr 311(1d)G, Ba 311(1d)G. These can be transcribed from the reference or obtained from the Basis Set Exchange.

resources.name: Hay-Wadt small-core effective core potentials for Ti, Sr, Ba

access.notes: Standard ECPs from Hay & Wadt 1984; included in many DFT program libraries.
